text:
maya: Quick idea — for the playground 'invoke log' let's surface parameter diffs inline and a small "schema validation" badge next to each call. Sketch: https://imgur.com/abcd1234

jonathan: link? can you paste the flow here or a short gif?

maya: pasted the small flow in comments, but gist: collapsed row with function name, status, duration; click peek to expand inline diffs and full json. Peek should not reflow the main editor.

sasha: love the diffs. accessibility nits: when peek expands it needs aria-expanded and focus management so screen readers land in the peeked content.

kevin: collapsing by default sounds good. for long runs we don't want the editor to jump. Peek should be available via keyboard (Enter/Space) and a visible affordance.

maya: agree collapse default. copy note: prefer "arguments" instead of "params", and "output" instead of "result" to match product voice.

jonathan: +1 to copy changes. Also suggest a tiny timestamp + token count summary on the compact row for quick cost signals.

sasha: accessibility nit: use aria-live=polite to announce "invoke expanded" and ensure the lint badge has a text alternative. avoid using color alone for warnings.

ux-bot: Screenshot uploaded: https://storage.internal/redwood/ux/proto-invokelog-v1.png :uploaded: 

kevin: implementation thought: reuse RunItem, add a small JsonDiffRenderer for the peek. We'll need to memoize heavy diffs to avoid perf hits on big payloads.

maya: sample keyboard hook (rough): ```js
// bind Enter to open peek when a run row is focused
row.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') openPeek(row.id)
})
```

jonathan: can we show schema-lint warnings as a small yellow dot with hover tooltip? would be less noisy than inline banners.

sasha: +1 but ensure contrast and provide an aria-label like "schema warnings: 2" so screen readers get context.

kevin: I'll prototype two states (A: compact collapsed, B: expanded by default for debug mode) and post screenshots tomorrow AM.

maya: thanks! checklist for PR description: 1) copy updates (params->arguments, result->output) 2) keyboard + SR announce 3) compact peek pattern 4) schema-lint badge + tooltip 5) runtime + token summary. I'll attach the sketch and mark design review done once we have screenshots. :thumbsup:
